flagshipProjects.title: V-Scan
flagshipProjects.summary: Windows desktop application that inspects files and URLs against VirusTotal's 70+ antivirus engines with instant color-coded verdicts and a detection gauge.
flagshipProjects.mechanism: Computes a local SHA-256 hash first so sensitive files are checked by hash without uploading, falling back to optional upload (up to 650 MB) only when explicitly requested.
architecture: Non-blocking worker threads keep the CustomTkinter interface responsive during API lookups.
Classifies responses into Clean (0 flags), Suspicious (1–4 flags), and Dangerous (5+ flags) with per-engine breakdowns.
Includes PyInstaller build pipeline (build.py) supporting standalone distribution without leaking API keys.
flagshipProjects.securityFocus: Privacy-first hash triage, threat intelligence integration, local key isolation.
flagshipProjects.commandHint: SHA-256 lookup -> VirusTotal v3 -> Verdict Engine
flagshipProjects.legalNote: Front-end for VirusTotal public API; designed as one verification layer alongside safe handling practices.

flagshipProjects.title: Six7 Security
flagshipProjects.summary: Modular anti-nuke and moderation bot for Discord communities built with slash-command configuration and persistent security controls.
flagshipProjects.mechanism: Combines a multi-stage Auto-Mod filter pipeline with in-memory join-velocity tracking that triggers automated raid lockdown and verification-level escalation.
architecture: Auto-Mod cog checks banned words, invite links, mass mentions, excessive caps, and spam rate-limits with 10-minute auto-timeout.
Anti-Raid cog tracks join timestamps per guild, flags young accounts, and initiates lockdown mode with configurable Kick/Ban/Log actions.
Persistent Discord UI verification button survives restarts via custom IDs; all events route to a central audit log channel.
flagshipProjects.securityFocus: Rate-limiting, raid anomaly thresholds, role-hierarchy permission boundaries, audit logging.

flagshipProjects.title: Phishing Detector
flagshipProjects.summary: Fast URL heuristic and reputation scanner evaluating incoming web addresses for homoglyph spoofing, credential-harvesting patterns, and suspicious domain signals.
flagshipProjects.mechanism: Executes layered lexical and structural analysis on target URLs, scoring entropy, IP address masquerading, excessive subdomains, and high-risk keywords before querying reputation checks.
architecture: Lightweight Python scanning engine scoring URLs against known deceptive URL patterns.
Detects suspicious TLDs, multi-level subdomains, and URL encoding tricks used in credential harvesting campaigns.
Generates clean terminal output with risk scoring and mitigation recommendations.
flagshipProjects.securityFocus: Social engineering triage, structural URL analysis, deception surface scoring.
flagshipProjects.legalNote: Passive lexical and heuristic analysis; does not interact with malicious endpoints or execute payloads.

flagshipProjects.title: PortScanner Nmap Pipeline
flagshipProjects.summary: Automated network reconnaissance wrapper leveraging Nmap to perform structured port discovery, service version detection, and target profiling.
flagshipProjects.mechanism: Wraps raw Nmap capabilities into a repeatable CLI pipeline that parameterizes scan intensity (SYN stealth vs. version probe) and exports clean diagnostic summaries.
architecture: Structured argument parser supporting targeted host ranges and port specifications (top 100, custom ranges, or full sweeps).
Parses Nmap output into readable service tables highlighting open, closed, and filtered states.
Built as a foundation for authorized network enumeration workflows and vulnerability discovery labs.
flagshipProjects.securityFocus: Network boundary enumeration, service fingerprinting, attack surface mapping.
flagshipProjects.legalNote: Strictly intended for systems and subnets you own or have explicit written permission to assess.

flagshipProjects.title: dns-recon Scanner
flagshipProjects.summary: Defensive reconnaissance and security auditing tool that assesses target domains for email spoofing susceptibility (SPF, DMARC, DKIM) and critical DNS hygiene vulnerabilities.
flagshipProjects.mechanism: Parses multi-tier DNS records validating RFC 7208 SPF lookup limits, RFC 7489 DMARC policy enforcement, public DKIM key sizes, and tests for open zone transfers (AXFR).
architecture: SPF validator traces recursive include: statements and checks the 10-lookup threshold to prevent PermError.
DMARC inspector flags relaxed alignment, partial percentages (pct < 100), and missing reporting (rua).
Automated security score generator outputting colored terminal summaries and structured JSON reports.
flagshipProjects.securityFocus: Phishing prevention, DNS infrastructure hygiene, crypto key size audit (<2048-bit RSA flags).
flagshipProjects.legalNote: Performs standard DNS queries and non-destructive zone transfer checks; compliant with passive reconnaissance best practices.

flagshipProjects.title: Jarvis Assistant
flagshipProjects.summary: Python-based desktop assistant executing local operating system tasks, voice command parsing, and system automation workflows.
flagshipProjects.mechanism: Listens for voice and text input, tokenizes intent using local speech recognition pipelines, and dispatches system commands through a modular action dispatcher.
architecture: Speech recognition and text-to-speech loop with configurable offline and online fallback modes.
Modular plugin architecture allowing custom skills (file operations, browser launching, system status monitoring).
Clean terminal telemetry logging all interpreted actions and system responses.
flagshipProjects.securityFocus: Command sanitization, local subprocess isolation, permission containment.

roadmap.detail: Building desktop scanners, bots, CLI security utilities, and web interfaces.
Packet behavior, port states, service fingerprinting, and perimeter controls.
Permissions, service management, bash scripting, and log inspection.
Reconnaissance, scanning, vulnerability analysis, system attacks, and web app security.
Automated email spoofing and DNS hygiene assessment engine with terminal and report exports.
